user.title: Set up Azure AI Tasks
user.description: Enter your Azure AI endpoint and API key. You will choose models in the next step.

data_description.endpoint: Your Azure OpenAI resource URL, e.g. https://YOUR-RESOURCE.openai.azure.com
data_description.api_key: A key from your Azure OpenAI resource (Keys and Endpoint blade)

models.title: Choose models
models.description: Pick from the model deployments found on your Azure resource, or type a deployment name manually. At least one model must be configured. Models marked '(no Responses API / web search)' can only use the Chat Completions path.

data.use_responses_api: Use Responses API (v1) for chat tasks

data_description.chat_model: Deployment used for text and data generation. See [model support](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/foundry-models/concepts/models-sold-directly-by-azure) for capabilities.
data_description.image_model: Deployment used for image generation (DALL-E, gpt-image-1, FLUX).
data_description.use_responses_api: Routes chat tasks to Azure's stable v1 Responses API - required for web search. [Responses API docs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/responses)
data_description.enable_web_search: Lets the model search the web (Grounding with Bing) before answering. Needs a GPT-4-class or later model, incurs per-search costs, and searched data leaves your Azure compliance boundary. Automatically uses the Responses API. [Web search docs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/web-search)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Azure AI Tasks
reconfigure.description: Update your Azure AI endpoint, API key, and model(s). At least one model must be configured. Models marked '(no Responses API / web search)' can only use the Chat Completions path.
